content: विसर्जनम् .²1 Emitting, sending forth, pouring down; समतया वसुवृष्टिविसर्जनैः <ls>R. 9. 6</ls>. .²2 Giving away, a gift, donation; <ls>R. 9. 6</ls>. .²3 Voiding; वाय्वग्निविप्रमादित्यमपः पश्यंस्तथैव गाः . न कदाचन कुर्वीत विण्मूत्रस्य विसर्जनम् .. <ls>Ms. 4. 48</ls>. .²4 Casting off, quitting, abandoning; श्रुतदेहविसर्जनः पितुः <ls>R. 8. 25</ls>. .²5 Sending away, dismissal. .²6 Allowing (the deity invoked) to go (<ab>opp.</ab> आवाहन). .²7 Setting a bull at liberty on certain occasions. .²8 Driving out (cows to pasture). .²9 Product, creation.
